mqttExternalBrokerNotice: External broker mode cannot detect device MQTT transport status. Device status shows 3 states (Online / Offline / Never Connected); the "Standby" state is unavailable. Data reporting and command dispatch are unaffected.

llm.thinkingToggleHint: Toggle reasoning mode. Turning it off saves tokens and reduces latency on simple queries.
llm.name: Name
llm.apiKeyHelp: Access key created in your provider's console
llm.cloudAddDesc: Pick a protocol path and fill in the endpoint details
llm.cloudProtocolHelp: OpenAI-compatible covers most providers; for Anthropic paste the base URL with or without /v1 (auto-appended), e.g. open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic
llm.cloudFillRequired: Name, endpoint, model and API key are required
llm.noBackendsDesc: Add an LLM backend to start using AI features
llm.noModelsFound: No models found. Click refresh to fetch from server
llm.builtinDesc: On-device agent model — no API key, fully offline. Pick one from the builtin catalog (downloads on first use).
llm.builtinNotEnabled: This server does not have the built-in model enabled
llm.builtinConfirmDelete: Delete the built-in LFM2.5-2.6B model? This removes the downloaded model files (~1.5GB) and stops the server.
llm.builtinDownloadInProgress: Download already running in the background
llm.firstRunBannerTitle: Get started with the built-in model
llm.firstRunBannerDesc: No LLM backend configured yet. Install the zero-config local model — no API key needed, fully offline.
llm.builtinWizardIntro: Install a zero-config on-device agent model. No API key needed — fully offline, data never leaves your device.
llm.builtinWizardOfflineValue: No network · data stays on device
llm.builtinWizardIdleHint: Pick the built-in model to download — it auto-activates when done and continues in the background.
llm.platformHintLinux: NeoMind downloads the CPU llama.cpp runtime on demand. Linux servers wanting GPU acceleration can run CUDA=1 scripts/build-llama-server.sh, then name the output neomind-llama-server on the PATH — it takes priority automatically.
llm.platformHintLinuxArm: This platform gets the CPU runtime. On GPU devices like Jetson, run CUDA=1 scripts/build-llama-server.sh on the device and name the output neomind-llama-server next to the binary or on the PATH — pure-CPU inference is noticeably slow on Jetson.
llm.platformHintWindows: Windows detected. With an NVIDIA GPU, set NEOMIND_BUILTIN_RUNTIME_VARIANT=cuda (plus NEOMIND_BUILTIN_MODEL_NGL=99) and restart the service for GPU acceleration; the CPU build is the default.
llm.builtinWizardDownloadingHint: Download continues in the background — closing this window won't interrupt it
llm.builtinWizardReadyDesc: The built-in model is downloaded and ready to use.
llm.builtinWizardReadyNotActive: The built-in model is ready. Activate it as your current backend?
llm.builtinWizardEngineStopped: The engine is not running. Start it to activate.

lfm25-2.6b.name: LFM2.5-2.6B
lfm25-2.6b.notes: Small + native 128K context (hybrid KV is cheap) — the default for tight hardware

qwen3.5-4b.name: Qwen3.5-4B
qwen3.5-4b.notes: Strongest edge agent in our 30-case evals (76% cmd_ok) — tool-calling first pick

gemma4-e2b.name: Gemma4-E2B
gemma4-e2b.notes: Official Google QAT quant — mmproj-ready for vision

llm.builtinEngineSettingsDesc: Tune the bundled inference engine (model {{model}}, default context {{def}}). The engine restarts on apply.
llm.builtinMemLow: Low available memory on this device (recommend ≥{{min}} GB free) — the model may fail to run or be very slow
llm.builtinMemLowInstalled: This model recommends ≥{{min}} GB free RAM; only {{avail}} GB available — inference may be very slow or fail. Consider a cloud backend or freeing memory.
llm.cloudCtxHelp: Real context length for custom backends (e.g. RKLLM3 -c 16384). Blank = default 128000
